credits_text: Starring PUGO & TOGO TONY SANTOS LILA LUNA Directed by Richard Abelardo
other_text: Madman or Scientist? See this amazing comedy-mystery teeming with giant animals! tiny human beings! A thousand and one thrills and laughs! Laughs and Thrills in the Year's Comedy-Mystery! Listen to LVN radio programs: every Thursday. DZPI, 8:00-8:30 p.m., with Pugo, Togo and Patsy. Every Sunday, 6:00-6:30 p.m., DZFM, conducted by Frankie Gomez.
description: A vintage poster advertises a comedy-mystery film featuring giant animals and tiny humans, starring Pugo, Togo, Tony Santos, and Lila Luna, directed by Richard Abelardo.
